- 75-85% compression (vs. 25-40% for vector DBs)
- Sub-10ms processing
- Tiered compression (HOT/WARM/COOL/COLD)
- Cross-recall technology (network effects)
- Production-ready, enterprise-grade Live demo: https://memorylayer-vrcr.netlify.app The technology is patent-pending

items.title: Show HN: I got Stability AI's small audio model into a consumer iOS app

The first issue I encountered was that Tensorflow Lite's Metal/GPU delegates don't seem to be able to run the three submodels, because many model operations are not supported. This left using the regular (cpu-bound) delegate using XNNPack to try and maximize performance. items.title: Ask HN: Can people please stop commenting on whether a submission is AI?
items.raw_excerpt: So many posts where half of the discussion is people debating whether or not the post is AI. It sucks all of the energy out of the site, and it would be better to point out the ways that the information is wrong, rather than whether it uses phrasing and punctuation that you associate with AI.

items.title: Transform your MCP architecture: Unite MCP servers through AgentCore Gateway
items.raw_excerpt: Earlier this year, we introduced Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, a fully managed service that serves as a centralized MCP tool server, providing a unified interface where agents can discover, access, and invoke tools. Today, we're extending support for existing MCP servers as a new target type in AgentCore Gateway. With this capability, you can group multiple task-specific MCP servers aligned to agent goals behind a single, manageable MCP gateway interface. This reduces the operational complexity of maintaining separate gateways, while providing the same centralized tool and authentication management that existed for REST APIs and AWS Lambda functions.
